crossRefs.note: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your…
The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

translations.web: “There is no peace”, says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”
translations.bsb: “There is no peace,” says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
translations.kjv: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
translations.asv: There is no peace, saith Jehovah, to the wicked.
